```{r}
packageVersion("apollo")
ls("package:apollo")
apollo_initialise()

```

Here need to make the data into wide format to create the utility functions.

```{r}
#after running Analysis

mlogit_cleann=mlogit_clean[c(1:11,15,19,38:47,71)]
mlogit_clean$Alternative[which(mlogit_clean$Alternative==1)]="alt1"
mlogit_clean$Alternative[which(mlogit_clean$Alternative=="2")]="alt2"
mlogit_clean$Alternative[which(mlogit_clean$Alternative=="3")]="alt3"
#mlogit_clean$Choice.Binary=NULL
#Note design_ngene still says 50
# mlogit_clean$Cost[which(mlogit_clean$Cost==50)]=40
mlogit_clean_wide=reshape(mlogit_clean,timevar = "Alternative",
idvar = c(1:3,5,7),
direction = "wide" ) # Each respondent-choice task becomes one row, with separate columns for each alternative’s attributes.

apollo_control <- list(
  modelName  = "Trail_Choice",
  modelDescr = "Simple MNL model with trail alternatives",
  indivID    = "RID" ,
  panelData = TRUE
)
database=mlogit_clean_wide

```

```{apollo_control = list(}
  
  modelName       = "resident_submodel",   
  
  modelDescr      = "Resident-only submodel for Swait-Louviere test",
  
  indivID         = "RID",                  # ID respondent ID column
  
  outputDirectory = "output"
  
)



database_resident <- subset(database, Resident == 1)

database_tourist  <- subset(database, Resident == 0)


# first run resident

apollo_beta_sub <- c(
  
  b_Habitat_QualityMed  = 0,
  
  b_Habitat_QualityHigh = 0,
  
  b_Trail_ConditionMed  = 0,
  
  b_Trail_ConditionHigh = 0,
  
  b_CrowdingMed         = 0,
  
  b_CrowdingLow         = 0,
  
  b_cost                = 0,
  
  asc_optout            = 0,
  
  b_age                 = 0,
  
  b_education           = 0,
  
  b_income              = 0,
  
  b_sex                 = 0
  
)

apollo_fixed_sub <- c()


apollo_probabilities_sub <- function(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs, functionality="estimate"){
  
  
  
  apollo_attach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs)
  
  on.exit(apollo_detach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs))
  
  
  
  P = list()
  
  V = list()
  
  
  
  V[["alt1"]] =
    
    b_Habitat_QualityMed  * Habitat_QualityM.alt1 +
    
    b_Habitat_QualityHigh * Habitat_QualityH.alt1 +
    
    b_Trail_ConditionMed  * Trail_ConditionM.alt1 +
    
    b_Trail_ConditionHigh * Trail_ConditionH.alt1 +
    
    b_CrowdingMed         * CrowdingM.alt1 +
    
    b_CrowdingLow         * CrowdingL.alt1 +
    
    b_cost                * Cost.alt1 +
    
    b_age        * Demo_Age_num +
    
    b_education  * CollegePlus +
    
    b_income     * HHIncome_num +
    
    b_sex        * Sex_binary
  
  
  
  V[["alt2"]] =
    
    b_Habitat_QualityMed  * Habitat_QualityM.alt2 +
    
    b_Habitat_QualityHigh * Habitat_QualityH.alt2 +
    
    b_Trail_ConditionMed  * Trail_ConditionM.alt2 +
    
    b_Trail_ConditionHigh * Trail_ConditionH.alt2 +
    
    b_CrowdingMed         * CrowdingM.alt2 +
    
    b_CrowdingLow         * CrowdingL.alt2 +
    
    b_cost                * Cost.alt2 +
    
    b_age        * Demo_Age_num +
    
    b_education  * CollegePlus +
    
    b_income     * HHIncome_num +
    
    b_sex        * Sex_binary
  
  
  
  V[["alt3"]] = asc_optout
  
  
  
  mnl_settings = list(
    
    alternatives = c(alt1=1, alt2=2, alt3=3),
    
    avail        = list(alt1=1, alt2=1, alt3=1),
    
    choiceVar    = choice,
    
    utilities    = V
    
  )
  
  
  
  P[["model"]] = apollo_mnl(mnl_settings, functionality)
  
  P = apollo_panelProd(P, apollo_inputs, functionality)
  
  P = apollo_prepareProb(P, apollo_inputs, functionality)
  
  return(P)
  
}


#estimate resident

apollo_control$modelName <- "resident_submodel"

database <- database_resident

apollo_inputs_resident <- apollo_validateInputs()


model_resident <- apollo_estimate(apollo_beta_sub, apollo_fixed_sub,
                                  
                                  apollo_probabilities_sub, apollo_inputs_resident)


apollo_modelOutput(model_resident)


#tourist only model

apollo_control$modelName <- "tourist_submodel"

database <- database_tourist

apollo_inputs_tourist <- apollo_validateInputs()


model_tourist <- apollo_estimate(apollo_beta_sub, apollo_fixed_sub,
                                 
                                 apollo_probabilities_sub, apollo_inputs_tourist)


apollo_modelOutput(model_tourist)


LL_resident <- model_resident$maximum

LL_tourist  <- model_tourist$maximum

LL_unrestricted <- LL_resident + LL_tourist

K <- length(apollo_beta_sub)   # 12


#adding free scale lamda for tourist

apollo_beta_scale <- c(apollo_beta_sub, lambda_tourist = 1)

apollo_fixed_scale <- c()


apollo_probabilities_scale <- function(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs, functionality="estimate"){
  
  
  
  apollo_attach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs)
  
  on.exit(apollo_detach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs))
  
  
  
  P = list()
  
  V = list()
  
  
  
  scale = ifelse(Resident==1, 1, lambda_tourist)
  
  
  
  V[["alt1"]] = scale * (
    
    b_Habitat_QualityMed  * Habitat_QualityM.alt1 +
      
      b_Habitat_QualityHigh * Habitat_QualityH.alt1 +
      
      b_Trail_ConditionMed  * Trail_ConditionM.alt1 +
      
      b_Trail_ConditionHigh * Trail_ConditionH.alt1 +
      
      b_CrowdingMed         * CrowdingM.alt1 +
      
      b_CrowdingLow         * CrowdingL.alt1 +
      
      b_cost                * Cost.alt1 +
      
      b_age        * Demo_Age_num +
      
      b_education  * CollegePlus +
      
      b_income     * HHIncome_num +
      
      b_sex        * Sex_binary
    
  )
  
  
  
  V[["alt2"]] = scale * (
    
    b_Habitat_QualityMed  * Habitat_QualityM.alt2 +
      
      b_Habitat_QualityHigh * Habitat_QualityH.alt2 +
      
      b_Trail_ConditionMed  * Trail_ConditionM.alt2 +
      
      b_Trail_ConditionHigh * Trail_ConditionH.alt2 +
      
      b_CrowdingMed         * CrowdingM.alt2 +
      
      b_CrowdingLow         * CrowdingL.alt2 +
      
      b_cost                * Cost.alt2 +
      
      b_age        * Demo_Age_num +
      
      b_education  * CollegePlus +
      
      b_income     * HHIncome_num +
      
      b_sex        * Sex_binary
    
  )
  
  
  
  V[["alt3"]] = scale * asc_optout
  
  
  
  mnl_settings = list(
    
    alternatives = c(alt1=1, alt2=2, alt3=3),
    
    avail        = list(alt1=1, alt2=1, alt3=1),
    
    choiceVar    = choice,
    
    utilities    = V
    
  )
  
  
  
  P[["model"]] = apollo_mnl(mnl_settings, functionality)
  
  P = apollo_panelProd(P, apollo_inputs, functionality)
  
  P = apollo_prepareProb(P, apollo_inputs, functionality)
  
  return(P)
  
}


apollo_control$modelName <- "pooled_scale_model"

database <- rbind(database_resident, database_tourist)   

#backed to pool

apollo_inputs_full <- apollo_validateInputs()


model_pooled_scale <- apollo_estimate(apollo_beta_scale, apollo_fixed_scale,
                                      
                                      apollo_probabilities_scale, apollo_inputs_full)


apollo_modelOutput(model_pooled_scale)


LL_restricted <- model_pooled_scale$maximum



#  Swait-Louviere likelihood ratio test


LR_stat <- -2 * (LL_restricted - LL_unrestricted)

df      <- K - 1

p_value <- pchisq(LR_stat, df, lower.tail = FALSE)


cat("LR statistic:", LR_stat, "\n")

cat("df:", df, "\n")

cat("p-value:", p_value, "\n")

cat("Estimated tourist scale (lambda):", model_pooled_scale$estimate["lambda_tourist"], "\n")
```
